def assign_norrec_diffs(df, diff_list):
    """Compute and write the difference between normal and reciprocal values
    for all columns specified in the diff_list parameter.

    Note that the DataFrame is directly written to. That is, it is changed
    during the call of this function. No need to use the returned object.

    Parameters
    ----------
    df: pandas.DataFrame
        Dataframe containing the data
    diff_list: list
        list of columns to compute differences for.

    Returns
    -------
    df_new: pandas.DataFrame
        The data with added columns
    """
    -------
        None
        """
        # First get the list of columns containing the reciprocal values
        reciprocal_columns = [col for col in df.columns if '_rec' in col]
        # Create a list of columns that contain the difference
        diff_columns = [col + '_diff' for col in diff_list]
        # Create a list of columns that contain the normal values
        normal_columns = [col.replace('_rec', '') for col in reciprocal_columns]
        # Compute the difference between normal and reciprocal values
        df[diff_columns] = df[normal_columns] / df[reciprocal_columns]
        # Write the result to the original dataframe
        df[normal_columns] = df[normal_columns] / df[reciprocal_columns]
        return None

def compute_mean_std(df, cols):
    """Compute the mean and standard deviation of the data.

    Parameters
    ----------
    df: pandas.DataFrame
        Dataframe containing the data
    cols: list
        List of columns to compute the mean and standard deviation for

    Returns
    -------
    pandas.DataFrame
        DataFrame containing the mean and standard deviation
    """
    return df[cols].mean().to_frame().join(df[cols].std().to_frame())
